gen-dafont-college-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Every curve in College is as heavy as its straight stems, with generous openings inside the tall lowercase, which gives it a stamped, confident look. Mochiy Pop P One is lighter on its feet, sans-serif and spaced wide.
gen-dafont-college-gf-montserrat-underli: Heavy curves that match the weight of the straight stems give College its blunt, commanding look. Montserrat Underline follows with sans-serif lowercase that looks oversized and round-bowled, so a long passage reads smoothly and without surprises.
gen-dafont-college-gf-mozilla-headline: College keeps its thin joins just as thick as its stems, so the heading looks cut from one slab. Mozilla Headline relaxes it with big-bodied lowercase.
gen-dafont-college-gf-mozilla-text: Chunky, confident, stamped from solid stock: that is College, with tall lowercase and roomy openings inside every curve. Mozilla Text sits next to it looking just as bold in the lowercase, with flared terminals softening the edges of that sturdy, sans-serif frame.
gen-dafont-college-gf-nata-sans: College draws every curve as heavy as its stems and leaves big openings inside its tall lowercase, so the headline feels punchy. Nata Sans brings a steady, technical-pen calm.
gen-dafont-college-gf-nobile: College looks drawn with one constant pen width, every curve as heavy as its straight stems, with large openings in the tall lowercase. Nobile, a plain sans, keeps capitals and lowercase close in height and its mouths open, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-dafont-college-gf-nokora: Nokora lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, with an s that never tightens up. College, sans-serif Nokora's partner, has no pinched joints or flared ends, and that bluntness is what makes them hold together.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic is modern and sans-serif, with a welcoming gap in the c and capitals barely above the lowercase. College is the louder one, with no thick-thin flicker and every curve as heavy as its stems.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans fills most of the letter height with its lowercase and keeps a wide-open c, so text feels full and clear. College's rod-stock horizontals and verticals make a rigid headline above it; sizing the sans-serif body modestly would suit that.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam reads full and tidy, with curve endings held well apart and tall, rounded c, s and z. College is the louder one, drawn with one-tip simplicity, so the pairing is simple strength against sheer clarity.
